prompt: Create a website for a meat packing plant
summary: A brochure-style website for Ironridge Meat Packing Co., a wholesale meat processing plant. The site presents the company's history, USDA certifications, product line (beef, pork, poultry cuts), wholesale ordering info, and contact/location details. Since all content is static company information and a read-only product catalog with no per-request logic, transactions, or data that changes after deployment, a single static_site is sufficient — filtering of the product catalog can be done client-side in the browser.

services.name: ironridge-meatpacking-site
services.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html about.html products.html wholesale.html quality.html contact.html styles.css common.js products.js dist/ && cp -r assets dist/ && cp -r specs dist/
